site.name: HOJA Network
site.metaDescription: HOJA Network is an African grassroots non-profit organization operating at the intersection of nature protection, clean energy, green entrepreneurship, and community resilience in Eastern DRC and the Great Lakes.

footer.about: HOJA Network operates in Eastern DRC and the Great Lakes region under DRC Registration No. JUST.G.S.112/S-KV/0508/2021 & Rwanda RGB e-Imiryango Law No. 058/2024.
